channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: পরীমনির বিরুদ্ধে মোবাইল ফোন ছিনিয়ে নেওয়ার অভিযোগ রবিউলের
item.description: রবিউল দাবি করেছেন যে চিত্রনায়িকা পরীমনি তার মুঠোফোনটি ছিনিয়ে নিয়েছেন। এই বিষয়ে নিজের পক্ষ থেকে বক্তব্য তুলে ধরেছেন তিনি।

item.title: বাংলাদেশের তিন অঞ্চল পুনরুদ্ধারের মন্তব্য ভারতীয় সংসদ সদস্যের
item.description: ভারতের ক্ষমতাসীন দলের এমপি নিশিকান্ত দুবে মন্তব্য করেছেন যে পাকিস্তাননিয়ন্ত্রিত কাশ্মীরের পাশাপাশি বাংলাদেশের নোয়াখালী, সিলেট ও চট্টগ্রাম পুনরুদ্ধার করার সময় এসেছে। নেহরুর নীতিকে এজন্য দায়ী করে তিনি এই বক্তব্য দেন।

item.title: গার্ড অব অনার ছাড়াই দাফন বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধার, পরিবারে ক্ষোভ
item.description: কুমিল্লার ব্রাহ্মণপাড়ায় রাষ্ট্রীয় সম্মান বা গার্ড অব অনার ছাড়াই দাফন করা হয়েছে বীর মুক্তিযোদ্ধা আব্দুস সাত্তারকে। দাফনের সময় প্রশাসনের কেউ উপস্থিত না থাকায় পরিবার ও স্থানীয় মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের মাঝে তীব্র ক্ষোভের সৃষ্টি হয়েছে।

item.title: Taiz market attack leaves 30 dead as rivals accuse each other
item.description: Following a deadly strike on al-Hadara market in Yemen's Taiz governorate, government forces and Houthi rebels blamed each other. The Houthi movement reported that at least 30 individuals died in the incident.

item.title: তিশা ও অথৈয়ের সদস্যপদ অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য স্থগিত
item.description: শুটিং সেটের মারধরের ঘটনায় পাল্টাপাল্টি অভিযোগের জেরে অভিনেত্রী তানজিন তিশা ও সামিয়া অথৈয়ের সদস্যপদ অনির্দিষ্টকালের জন্য স্থগিত করেছে অভিনয়শিল্পী সংঘ। বিরোধ মেটানোর একাধিক প্রচেষ্টা ব্যর্থ হওয়ার পর এই বড় সিদ্ধান্ত এল।

item.title: Mohammed Shami steps away from Test cricket
item.description: Indian pace bowler Mohammed Shami has decided to retire from Test cricket. He was previously considered one of the squad's leading performers.

item.title: Meta introduces custom spaces feature within its Muse AI
item.description: Meta's Muse AI now features a spaces tool enabling users to create tailored, app-like environments. People can interact with these custom hubs for shopping, education, music tracking, and trivia.

item.title: Mumbai high-rise fire in Ghatkopar East injures three people
item.description: A blaze broke out in a Mumbai residential tower after a short circuit caused by drilling for Diwali lights. Three individuals were hospitalized following the incident in Ghatkopar East.

item.title: Fast bowler Mohammed Shami concludes his Test career
item.description: On Friday, 36-year-old speedster Mohammed Shami stepped away from Test cricket, marking thirteen years since his 2013 debut against the West Indies. He finishes the red-ball format with 64 appearances and 229 total wickets.

item.title: Locals claim Bengaluru multiple-murder suspect intimidated them
item.description: Neighbours living near Indushekhar alleged that the suspect, linked to seven murders, intimidated local residents for years. Anand E., a local political party president whose office is situated beneath the suspect's residence, reported receiving threats.

item.title: Telangana High Court serves contempt notices to six officials
item.description: Judicial authorities in Telangana initiated contempt proceedings against six government officials regarding the unauthorized destruction of a farmhouse.

item.title: Legislative committee inspects Kerala tourism initiatives
item.description: Officials evaluated tourism development initiatives aboard a backwater houseboat. K.C. Venugopal stated that the objective is to upgrade facilities to international benchmarks while identifying new locations.

item.title: Disappearance report exposes seven murders in Bengaluru
item.description: Law enforcement officials indicated that a missing person investigation ultimately exposed a series of seven homicides. According to investigators, the suspect's wife, Sunita, and mother-in-law, Roopavathi, were the initial victims.

item.title: DVAC names former minister Duraimurugan in sand mining inquiry
item.description: Anti-corruption authorities registered a case against former minister Duraimurugan following an enforcement agency alert concerning illegal sand extraction. Raids across 34 sites yielded numerous evidentiary files.

item.title: Thomas Markle arrested by the FBI in the United States
item.description: Thomas Markle Sr., father of Meghan Markle, was taken into custody by federal agents at a Florida retirement facility. The Justice Department stated the arrest stems from allegations involving child sexual abuse material.

item.title: Agriculture Minister announces three-day Krishi mela duration
item.description: The upcoming agricultural fair will span three days rather than the previously scheduled single day, according to the Agriculture Minister.

item.title: Valencia Faces Real Madrid in La Liga Fixture
item.description: Real Madrid visits struggling Valencia with an opportunity to temporarily tie Barcelona at the top of the La Liga standings.

item.title: NBR Bank Account Freezes Spark Business Concern
item.description: The National Board of Revenue has frozen accounts of various business entities over suspected garment sector unrest, causing anxiety among prominent entrepreneurs.

item.title: The Legacy of Ronaldo's Iconic Number Seven Jersey
item.description: Even after his retirement, Cristiano Ronaldo remains deeply associated with the number seven shirt worn throughout his twenty-three-year career.

item.title: Nigerian High Court Disqualifies Opposition Leadership
item.description: A Nigerian court has removed the executive committee of the opposition ADC party shortly before upcoming elections.

item.title: Coimbatore and Tiruppur Form Canal Water Patrols
item.description: Special teams are established across Coimbatore and Tiruppur to prevent unauthorized extraction of water from agricultural irrigation canals.

item.title: Amazon Prepares Melania Trump Two-Part Series
item.description: Amazon plans to premiere a two-part Prime Video show titled Melania: The Series on November 20, following a documentary released earlier in the year.

item.title: Wales Considers Energy Drink Sales Ban for Youths
item.description: Welsh authorities have announced intentions to prohibit the sale of high-caffeine energy drinks to minors under sixteen years of age.

item.title: Tribal Leader Dies by Suicide After Facebook Live
item.description: Former 2024 assembly candidate Nisha Bhagat died by suicide shortly after a livestream alleging harassment by state officials and brokers.

item.title: Paraguay leader faces scrutiny amid Ueno bank collapse
item.description: President Santiago Pena faces criticism regarding his connections to the parent company of the recently failed Ueno bank.

item.title: Myanmar military schedules by-elections for next April
item.description: Myanmar will hold by-elections in April, reflecting the military junta's growing assurance in territorial governance following recent battlefield gains.

item.title: মার্কিন গোয়েন্দারা প্রকাশ করলেন চীনের গোপন স্পেসপ্লেনের ছবি
item.description: যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের গোয়েন্দা সংস্থা চীনের গোপন ও মানবহীন শেনলং স্পেসপ্লেনের ছবি প্রকাশ করেছে। ২০২০ সাল থেকে এই যানটি কক্ষপথে একাধিক দীর্ঘমেয়াদি মিশন পরিচালনা করেছে।

item.title: Migrant worker arrested in Perumbavoor over stepson death
item.description: Police in Perumbavoor arrested a migrant worker after an autopsy revealed a fatal head injury in a toddler. Authorities also gathered testimonies about prior physical abuse.

item.title: Providence voters approve municipal divestment from Israel
item.description: Residents in Providence, Rhode Island, passed a ballot measure urging the local government to end financial investments linked to genocide in Israel.

item.title: হত্যা মামলায় রিমান্ড শেষ, কারাগারে পাঠানো হলো তরুণীকে
item.description: অবসরপ্রাপ্ত বিমানবাহিনী কর্মকর্তা তাহসিফ সাউরি হত্যা মামলায় গ্রেপ্তার ১৯ বছরের তরুণীকে রিমান্ড শেষে কারাগারে পাঠানো হয়েছে। পুলিশ জানায়, জিজ্ঞাসাবাদে তিনি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ তথ্য দিয়েছেন যা যাচাই করা হচ্ছে।

item.title: Historical Olympic arts competitions included a poetry gold
item.description: The 1912 Olympics featured arts contests where founder Pierre de Coubertin secretly won a poetry gold medal using pseudonyms.

item.title: US Consulate seeks critical minerals partnership with Singareni
item.description: Representatives from the US Consulate held discussions with officials from Singareni Collieries to explore collaboration opportunities in critical minerals.

item.title: Parliamentarian urges young people to become job and wealth creators
item.description: An MP has encouraged the younger generation to focus on building wealth. The official delivered this message to youth.

item.title: মিরপুরে যুব মহিলা লীগ নেত্রীকে নির্যাতনের দাবিটি কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা দিয়ে ছড়ানো
item.description: ঢাকার মিরপুরে যুব মহিলা লীগ নেত্রীকে নির্যাতনের অভিযোগে ফেসবুকে ছড়িয়ে পড়া ছবিটি কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা দিয়ে তৈরি। প্রথম আলোর যাচাইয়ে দেখা গেছে, অর্ধশতাধিক অ্যাকাউন্ট থেকে এই ভুয়া তথ্য প্রচার করা হলেও ওই নারীর কোনো খোঁজ মেলেনি।

item.title: Kummanam Rajasekharan claims opposition aims to destabilize democracy
item.description: BJP leader Kummanam Rajasekharan stated that opposition parties are trying to harm democratic institutions. He added that their protests are designed to cause instability.

item.title: Two police officers arrested for allegedly robbing a man close to Nehru Maidan
item.description: Law enforcement officials have taken two police personnel into custody. The suspects are accused of committing a robbery against an individual near Nehru Maidan.

item.title: Israeli opposition figures compromise on ultra-Orthodox draft to remove Netanyahu
item.description: Opposition politician Avigdor Liberman stated that compromises are necessary to unseat Prime Minister Netanyahu and prevent new elections. He emphasized that demanding everything could lead to total failure.

item.title: FBI detains Thomas Markle, Meghan Markle's father, over abuse material
item.description: Federal agents arrested Thomas Markle regarding child sexual abuse images found at his former residence. Meghan Markle previously stated she was deeply upset by these allegations.

item.title: Russia accelerates Rassvet satellite network development to counter Starlink
item.description: Russia's Security Council is speeding up the deployment of its Rassvet satellite constellation to rival Starlink. Moscow has launched 32 satellites this year to bolster military communications in Ukraine despite current network limitations.

item.title: Reports indicate outsiders can rent access to White House IP addresses
item.description: Security firms and reports reveal that software running on White House networks may allow external users to rent presidential IP access for a small fee. The activity was highlighted by investigators including Krebs on Security.

item.title: USCIRF Representatives Alleged Vigilante Violence Against Indian Gurdwaras
item.description: Two members of the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom asserted that gurdwaras in India face vigilante assaults. New Delhi has previously dismissed the commission as a prejudiced body lacking trustworthiness.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Establishes New Framework to Stop Illegal Mineral Extraction
item.description: The state administration of Andhra Pradesh released a government order outlining departmental duties to stop unauthorized sand and mineral mining. The directive mandates prompt complaint reviews, cooperative inspections, and strict penalties for negligent personnel.

item.title: মক্তবের শিক্ষক শিশু ধর্ষণের চেষ্টার অভিযোগে গ্রেপ্তার
item.description: শিশুটির মায়ের করা মামলায় শুক্রবার দুপুরে এক মক্তব শিক্ষককে গ্রেপ্তার করে পুলিশ। পরে তাকে আদালতের মাধ্যমে কারাগারে পাঠানো হয়।

item.title: Andhra Pradesh May Experience Scattered Rainfall Through November 12
item.description: Meteorological conditions suggest that parts of Andhra Pradesh could witness scattered precipitation up until November 12. Authorities have not issued severe weather warnings regarding these expected showers.

item.title: DMK Seeks Impartial Inquiry Into Periyar Arivulagam Book Procurement
item.description: Ex-minister Govi. Chezhiaan released a statement calling for an unbiased investigation into book acquisition practices. This followed remarks by Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay holding the prior DMK administration accountable for the matter.

item.title: Fuel Retailers Dispute Karnataka Official's Claim of Excess Ethanol in E20
item.description: State-run fuel retailers disputed assertions by a Karnataka minister alleging E20 petrol contains over thirty percent ethanol. Major oil firms stated the measurements failed to follow official technical guidelines and statutory testing methods.

item.title: Human Rights Panel Seeks Explanation From Anantapur Officials Over Violence
item.description: The State Human Rights Commission sent official inquiries to the district collector and education department representatives in Anantapur. The action follows an incident of violence reported in Raptadu.

item.title: Karnataka Official Claims E20 Fuel Exceeds Ethanol Limits and Seeks Fund
item.description: State minister Rizwan Arshad stated that local testing of sixty-three petrol samples revealed up to 31.2 percent ethanol content instead of the standard twenty percent. He subsequently called for the establishment of a consumer compensation fund in Bengaluru.

item.title: NIT Trichy opens artificial intelligence lab with TCS support
item.description: The National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli has inaugurated a new laboratory focused on artificial intelligence and machine learning. This facility was established with financial backing from the TCS Foundation.

item.title: Kobo introduces paid subscription for cloud ebook syncing
item.description: Kobo is rolling out a paid monthly subscription tier named Stack. The service enables users to store personal documents and ebooks on company servers to synchronize notes, reading spots, and highlights across various applications and gadgets.

item.title: US voters approve stricter controls on data centers
item.description: Recent United States midterm elections featured 41 ballot initiatives concerning data facilities. Voters approved tighter regulations on these centers in all but one of the proposed local measures.

item.title: Ongole boat capsize: two more bodies of T.N. fishermen wash ashore, toll rises to seven
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, N. fishermen wash ashore, toll rises to seven. Key points: Ongole, ongole, capsize, bodies.

item.title: Precipitation threatens Wellington one day international
item.description: Adverse weather conditions and persistent rain forecast threaten to disrupt the second One Day International cricket fixture scheduled between the national teams of India and New Zealand.

item.title: India prepares to enter Horizon Europe research initiative
item.description: India is poised to participate in the European Union's Horizon Europe scientific funding initiative once final procedures conclude. The agreement will allow domestic institutions, firms, and academics to access grants and collaborate on EU projects starting January 2027.

item.title: Minneapolis Frank Lloyd Wright property drops price to $2.495M
item.description: A Minneapolis residential property designed by Frank Lloyd Wright near Cedar Lake has returned to the real estate market. The three-bedroom Usonian house is listed at $2.495 million following an unsuccessful prior attempt to sell at $3.4 million.

item.title: Fraudulent crowdfunding campaign gathers funds following fatal crash
item.description: A deceptive fundraising page created on GoFundMe collected $5,000 following a fatal automobile accident in Florida that claimed the life of a teenager.

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Shares Bounce Back After Market Losses
item.description: Technology equities recovered following a period of heavy selling by shareholders who feared a Democratic win might decelerate artificial intelligence progress.

item.title: The iPhone Duo has more than 100,000 optimized apps, Apple says
item.description: As reported by The Verge, Apple's iPhone Duo was officially on sale for two weeks, and the company stated today that the App Store now has over 100,000 apps that are built for the foldable. "It's been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we're grate…. Key points: Apple, App Store, iphone, apple.

item.title: Salman Khan Addresses Biopic Speculation in Mumbai
item.description: At a promotional gathering in Mumbai, actor Salman Khan stated that a biographical film about him would ruin numerous reputations. He also noted his current project focuses on the Galwan clash.

item.title: সংস্কার কার্যক্রম বাধাগ্রস্ত করছে প্রশাসন: নাহিদ ইসলাম
item.description: জুলাই সনদ বাস্তবায়নে গণভোটের রায় উপেক্ষিত হচ্ছে বলে অভিযোগ করেছেন জাতীয় নাগরিক পার্টির আহ্বায়ক নাহিদ ইসলাম। জয়পুরহাটে তিনি দাবি করেন, বর্তমান প্রশাসন সামগ্রিক সংস্কার কার্যক্রম ব্যাহত করার চেষ্টা চালাচ্ছে।
